prompt: Create exactly ONE game sprite animation sheet containing exactly SIX isolated depictions of the SAME single falling English oak, elongated blade with 4 pairs of soft rounded lobes leaf, muted ochre yellow. Use large consistent negative gutters between six sprites, no second row. True RGBA transparent output.
